stop_timeout_root_cause.server_accept_behavior_before: single accepted client was handled synchronously before returning to accept
stop_timeout_root_cause.motion_execution_behavior_before: move_joints_sequential ran synchronously in the client handler, so the server could not accept a separate stop connection while the main client was busy
stop_timeout_root_cause.socket_lock_before: MvpTcpClient did not protect the full connect/send/recv/parse cycle with one request lock

confirmation_mismatch_root_cause.after: user-facing --confirm requires ROS2_WRIST_ROLL_2DEG; bridge keeps MVP_MOVE as internal TCP protocol confirmation

main_client_behavior_before: ROS2 polling, execute, and stop could all use the same MvpTcpClient socket path.
stop_client_behavior_before: stop did not create a dedicated short-lived client.
server_accept_behavior_before: server accepted one client and handled it until disconnect before accepting another.
motion_execution_behavior_before: motion execution could block the request handler that held the active client connection.
main_client_after: ROS2 bridge uses _main_client for get_state and move_joints_sequential only.
